title: The Lost One's Shadow
text: A shadow walks the road ahead of you with no one casting it, long and thin in the noon sun. It has the shape of one of your Lost: the slump of the shoulders, the hitch in the step. It stops when you stop. It does not turn around.

options.label: Follow the shadow where it walks.

outcomes.text: It walks you, never turning, to the place where it was lost.
It walks you to what took it, and then it is gone, and the thing is not.

options.label: The wisest speaks to the shadow.

outcomes.text: It does not answer. It only lifts an arm that is not there and points toward the hills, and the cold of it stays with you.

options.label: It is an ill omen. Go around it.

outcomes.text: It waits by the road as you pass, and its head turns to follow you, though it has no face to turn.
